    ∃ st x, d.stacks[j]? = some st ∧ st.blocks.getLast? = some x ∧ 0 < extra ∧ x.auth = b ∧
      x.base + x.size = st.top ∧ ReleasePre d.s b ∧
      (d.s.Active st.internal ∧ MetaRightM d.s st.arena ∧ x.dst ∉ cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) ∧
      x.base + x.size + extra ≤ st.cells.length ∧
      IssueSeq k (releaseEff d.s b) st (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst ∧
      d' = { d with
        s := issueSeqEff (releaseEff d.s b) st (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)) x.dst
        stacks := d.stacks.set j
          { st with
            top := x.base + x.size + extra
            blocks := st.blocks.dropLast ++ [⟨x.base, x.size + extra, d.s.A.length, x.dst⟩] } } := by
  unfold grow at h
  split at h
  · cases h
  · rename_i st hst
    split at h
    · cases h
    · rename_i x hx
      split at h
      · rename_i hc
        split at h
        · split at h
          · cases h
            exact ⟨st, x, hst, hx, hc.1, hc.2.1, hc.2.2.1, hc.2.2.2.1, hc.2.2.2.2, by assumption,
              by assumption, rfl⟩
          · cases h
        · cases h
      · cases h

/-! ## The kernel part of the library is reached -/

theorem releaseEff_len (s : S3) (a : Nat) : (releaseEff s a).A.length = s.A.length := by
  unfold releaseEff; split <;> simp

theorem releaseEff_I (s : S3) (a : Nat) : (releaseEff s a).I = s.I := by
  unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl

theorem releaseEff_P (s : S3) (a : Nat) : (releaseEff s a).P = s.P := by
  unfold releaseEff; split <;> rfl

omit [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] in
/-- The derived `issue` is a `split` step then a `store` step of `Reachable` (O2, O8). -/
theorem issueSeq_reach {statics : Statics} {s : S3} {st : Stack} {r : List Nat} {dst : Nat}
    (hr : Reachable k statics s) (h : IssueSeq k s st r dst) :
    Reachable k statics (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena r)) ∧
      Reachable k statics (issueSeqEff s st r dst) := by
  have h1 : Reachable k statics (s.addAuth (blockOf s st.arena r)) :=
    .split hr (rs := [r]) (src := st.internal) (.ok h.1)
  exact ⟨h1, .store h1 (.ok h.2)⟩

end Inv

section InvK
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

theorem dexec_kernel {d d' : DS} {o : Op} (h : dexec k d (.kernel o) = .ok d') :
    kexec k d.s o = some d'.s ∧ d'.stacks = d.stacks ∧ d'.fresh = d.fresh := by
  simp only [dexec] at h
  split at h
  · split at h
    · rename_i hs; cases h; exact ⟨hs, rfl, rfl⟩
    · cases h
  · cases h

/-- Every `ok` step of the library takes kernel steps of `Reachable` only. -/
theorem dexec_reach {statics : Statics} {d d' : DS} {o : DOp} (hr : Reachable k statics d.s)
    (h : dexec k d o = .ok d') : Reachable k statics d'.s := by
  cases o with
  | kernel o => exact reachable_step hr (kexec_step (dexec_kernel h).1)
  | newStack st i => obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := newStack_ok h; exact hr
  | push j size dst =>
    obtain ⟨st, -, -, -, hseq, rfl⟩ := push_ok h; exact (issueSeq_reach hr hseq).2
  | mark j => obtain ⟨st, -, rfl⟩ := mark_ok h; exact hr
  | rewind j m =>
    obtain ⟨st, -, -, ⟨hsp, hrel⟩, rfl⟩ := rewind_ok h
    have h1 : Reachable k statics (d.s.addAuth (blockOf d.s st.arena (above st m))) :=
      .split hr (rs := [above st m]) (src := st.internal) (.ok hsp)
    exact .release h1 (.ok hrel)
  | grow j b extra =>
    obtain ⟨st, x, -, -, -, -, -, hrel, -, -, hseq, rfl⟩ := grow_ok h
    exact (issueSeq_reach (.release hr (.ok hrel)) hseq).2

theorem drun_reach {statics : Statics} : ∀ {d d' : DS} {os : List DOp},
    Reachable k statics d.s → drun k d os = some d' → Reachable k statics d'.s
  | d, d', [], hr, h => by simp only [drun, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact hr
  | d, d', o :: os, hr, h => by
    simp only [drun] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i d₁ h₁; exact drun_reach (dexec_reach hr h₁) h
    · cases h

end InvK

/-! ## Theorems of the brief -/

/-- An active descendant of `a` covering `l`, whatever its mode, takes the effective `Modify` of `a`
on `l` away (§43, cases 3 and 4). -/
theorem effective_ne_modify_of_active_desc {s : S3} {a j l : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : s.A[j]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hl : l ∈ y.footprint) (hj : a ∈ s.ancs j) :
    effective s a l ≠ some .modify := by
  intro he
  obtain ⟨x, -, -, -, hx⟩ := effective_some he
  have hmem : y.mode ∈ descModes s a l := mem_descModes.2 ⟨j, y, hy, ya, hl, hj, rfl⟩
  rcases effOf_cases hx with ⟨h0, -⟩ | ⟨-, -, h1⟩
  · rw [h0] at hmem; simp at hmem
  · cases h1

theorem getElem?_set_cases {α : Type} {l : List α} {j i : Nat} {v x : α}
    (h : (l.set j v)[i]? = some x) : (i = j ∧ x = v) ∨ (i ≠ j ∧ l[i]? = some x) := by
  rw [List.getElem?_set] at h
  by_cases hij : j = i
  · subst hij; simp only [↓reduceIte] at h; split at h
    · cases h; exact .inl ⟨rfl, rfl⟩
    · cases h
  · simp only [hij, ↓reduceIte] at h; exact .inr ⟨Ne.symm hij, h⟩

theorem getElem?_append_single {α : Type} {l : List α} {x y : α} {i : Nat}
    (h : (l ++ [x])[i]? = some y) : l[i]? = some y ∨ (i = l.length ∧ y = x) := by
  rw [List.getElem?_append] at h
  split at h
  · exact .inl h
  · rename_i hi
    have : i - l.length = 0 := by
      cases hc : i - l.length with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n => rw [hc] at h; simp at h
    rw [this] at h; simp at h
    exact .inr ⟨by omega, h.symm⟩

theorem not_mem_takeWhile_ne {m : Mark} : ∀ l : List Mark, m ∉ l.takeWhile (· ≠ m)
  | [] => by simp
  | a :: l => by
    rw [List.takeWhile_cons]
    split
    · rename_i ha
      intro hm
      rcases List.mem_cons.1 hm with rfl | hm
      · simp at ha
      · exact not_mem_takeWhile_ne l hm
    · simp

theorem takeWhile_ne_append {m : Mark} : ∀ {pre : List Mark} (post : List Mark), m ∉ pre →
    (pre ++ m :: post).takeWhile (· ≠ m) = pre
  | [], post, _ => by simp
  | a :: pre, post, h => by
    have ha : a ≠ m := fun e => h (e ▸ List.mem_cons_self ..)
    have ih := takeWhile_ne_append (pre := pre) post (fun h' => h (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h'))
    have ha' : decide (a ≠ m) = true := by simpa using ha
    rw [List.cons_append, List.takeWhile_cons]; simp only [ha', ↓reduceIte, ih]

theorem take_prefix_take_add {α : Type} : ∀ (l : List α) (n e : Nat), l.take n <+: l.take (n + e)
  | [], n, e => ⟨[], by rw [List.take_nil, List.take_nil]; rfl⟩
  | _ :: _, 0, _ => ⟨_, List.nil_append _⟩
  | a :: l, n + 1, e => by
    obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := take_prefix_take_add l n e
    exact ⟨t, by rw [Nat.add_right_comm, List.take_succ_cons, List.take_succ_cons, List.cons_append, ht]⟩

theorem cellsOf_prefix (st : Stack) (b n e : Nat) : cellsOf st b n <+: cellsOf st b (n + e) :=
  take_prefix_take_add _ _ _

section Thms
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')]

/-- `rewind_rejects_live_above` (brief): `rewind m` of a live mark is rejected when an active
authority derived from `internal` covers a cell above `m` (`above`, the cells that the rewind
returns): its effective `Modify` on that cell is gone, so `split` of `internal` on the cells above
`m` is rejected (O2.1). The brief's "couvre une région émise après `m`" is read on the cells that the
rewind returns (`above`; report, (f)). -/
theorem rewind_rejects_live_above {d : DS} {j : Nat} {st : Stack} {m : Mark}
    (hst : d.stacks[j]? = some st) (hm : m ∈ st.marks) {x l : Nat} {y : Authority}
    (hy : d.s.A[x]? = some y) (ya : y.active = true) (hx : st.internal ∈ d.s.ancs x)
    (hly : l ∈ y.footprint) (hl : l ∈ above st m) : rewind k d j m = .reject := by
  have hn : ¬ RewindSeq k d.s st m := fun h =>
    effective_ne_modify_of_active_desc hy ya hly hx (h.1.2.2.1 _ (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hl)
  simp [rewind, hst, hm, hn]

/-- `rewind_rejects_live_above` read on an `ok` (its contrapositive): an `ok` of `rewind m` is the
rewind of a live mark of the stack above which no active authority derived from `internal` covers a
cell. The converse of `rewind_rejects_live_above` does not hold: `rewind` also rejects when the
current frame cannot exercise `internal` (see `rewind`). -/
theorem rewind_ok_no_live_above {d d' : DS} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} (h : rewind k d j m = .ok d') :
    ∃ st, d.stacks[j]? = some st ∧ m ∈ st.marks ∧
      ∀ (x : Nat) (y : Authority), d.s.A[x]? = some y → y.active = true →
        st.internal ∈ d.s.ancs x → ∀ l ∈ y.footprint, l ∉ above st m := by
  obtain ⟨st, hst, hm, hseq, -⟩ := rewind_ok h
  exact ⟨st, hst, hm, fun x y hy ya hx l hly hl => effective_ne_modify_of_active_desc hy ya hly hx
    (hseq.1.2.2.1 _ (List.mem_singleton_self _) l hl)⟩

/-- `rewind_keeps_older_marks` (brief): after `rewind m`, the marks of the stack are those older than
`m`, `m` and the later marks are removed, the top is the top of `m` (the cells above return to the
available part), the other stacks are unchanged and no initialisation changes. -/
theorem rewind_keeps_older_marks {d d' : DS} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} (h : rewind k d j m = .ok d')
    {st : Stack} (hst : d.stacks[j]? = some st) {pre post : List Mark}
    (hs : st.marks = pre ++ m :: post) (hpre : m ∉ pre) :
    (∃ st', d'.stacks[j]? = some st' ∧ st'.marks = pre ∧ st'.top = m.top) ∧
      (∀ i, i ≠ j → d'.stacks[i]? = d.stacks[i]?) ∧ d'.s.I = d.s.I := by
  obtain ⟨st₀, hst₀, -, -, rfl⟩ := rewind_ok h
  rw [hst] at hst₀; cases hst₀
  have hj : j < d.stacks.length := lt_of_getElem? hst
  refine ⟨⟨_, List.getElem?_set_self hj, ?_, rfl⟩, fun i hi => List.getElem?_set_ne (Ne.symm hi),
    ?_⟩
  · simp only; rw [hs]; exact takeWhile_ne_append post hpre
  · show (releaseEff _ _).I = _; rw [releaseEff_I]; rfl

/-- The blocks of the arrival state of `grow`: the authority of the new block is at the index
`d.s.A.length`, the release keeping the length of `A`. -/
theorem grow_new_auth {s : S3} {st : Stack} {r : List Nat} {b dst : Nat} :
    (issueSeqEff (releaseEff s b) st r dst).afp s.A.length = r := by
  have hy₀ := addAuth_self (releaseEff s b) (blockOf (releaseEff s b) st.arena r)
  unfold issueSeqEff
  rw [storeEff_eq hy₀, releaseEff_len]
  simp only [S3.afp]
  rw [List.getElem?_set_self (by simp [S3.addAuth, releaseEff_len])]
  rfl

/-- `grow_same_base` (brief): the `ok` of `grow b extra` releases `b`, the last block (inactive in
the arrival state), and gives the stack a last block of the same base, of size `size + extra`, with
the same recorded destination; its authority covers the cells from the same base and is held by that
destination; the old cells are a prefix of the new ones. -/
theorem grow_same_base {d d' : DS} {j b extra : Nat} (h : grow k d j b extra = .ok d') :
    ∃ st x st', d.stacks[j]? = some st ∧ st.blocks.getLast? = some x ∧ x.auth = b ∧ 0 < extra ∧
      d'.stacks[j]? = some st' ∧
      st'.blocks.getLast? = some ⟨x.base, x.size + extra, d.s.A.length, x.dst⟩ ∧
      d'.s.afp d.s.A.length = cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra) ∧
      d'.s.A[d.s.A.length]?.map (·.holder) = some (.place x.dst) ∧
      cellsOf st x.base x.size <+: cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra) ∧
      d'.s.A[b]?.map (·.active) = some false := by
  obtain ⟨st, x, hst, hx, hex, hb, -, hrel, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := grow_ok h
  have hj : j < d.stacks.length := lt_of_getElem? hst
  have hy₀ := addAuth_self (releaseEff d.s b)
    (blockOf (releaseEff d.s b) st.arena (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)))
  refine ⟨st, x, _, hst, hx, hb, hex, List.getElem?_set_self hj, by simp, grow_new_auth, ?_,
    cellsOf_prefix st _ _ _, ?_⟩
  · show (issueSeqEff _ _ _ _).A[d.s.A.length]?.map _ = _
    unfold issueSeqEff; rw [storeEff_eq hy₀]; simp only
    rw [← releaseEff_len d.s b, List.getElem?_set_self (by simp [S3.addAuth])]; rfl
  · obtain ⟨⟨y, hy, -⟩, -⟩ := hrel
    have hbl : b < d.s.A.length := lt_of_getElem? hy
    show (issueSeqEff _ _ _ _).A[b]?.map _ = _
    unfold issueSeqEff; rw [storeEff_eq hy₀]; simp only
    rw [List.getElem?_set_ne (by rw [releaseEff_len]; omega),
      addAuth_lt (by rw [releaseEff_len]; exact hbl), releaseEff_eq hy, List.getElem?_set_self hbl]
    rfl

/-- `grow_keeps_prefix_init` (brief): `grow` changes the initialisation of no cell of the old block:
`release` and `split` change no initialisation, and `store` initialises only the destination, which
the new block does not cover (O8.3). -/
theorem grow_keeps_prefix_init {d d' : DS} {j b extra : Nat} (h : grow k d j b extra = .ok d')
    {st : Stack} {x : Blk} (hst : d.stacks[j]? = some st) (hx : st.blocks.getLast? = some x) :
    ∀ l ∈ cellsOf st x.base x.size, d'.s.I l = d.s.I l := by
  obtain ⟨st₀, x₀, hst₀, hx₀, -, -, -, -, -, -, ⟨-, hstore⟩, rfl⟩ := grow_ok h
  rw [hst] at hst₀; cases hst₀; rw [hx] at hx₀; cases hx₀
  intro l hl
  have hy₀ := addAuth_self (releaseEff d.s b)
    (blockOf (releaseEff d.s b) st.arena (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)))
  obtain ⟨-, hu, -, hcov, -, hleaf, -, -, -⟩ := hstore
  have hlr : l ∈ (S3.addAuth (releaseEff d.s b)
      (blockOf (releaseEff d.s b) st.arena (cellsOf st x.base (x.size + extra)))).afp
        (releaseEff d.s b).A.length := by
    simp only [S3.afp, hy₀]; exact (cellsOf_prefix st x.base x.size extra).subset hl
  have hne : l ≠ x.dst := by
    intro he; rw [he] at hlr
    exact (hcov x.dst hlr).1 (mem_footprint.2 ⟨hu.lt, hleaf, hu.lt, .inl rfl⟩)
  show (issueSeqEff _ _ _ _).I l = _
  unfold issueSeqEff; rw [storeEff_eq hy₀]
  simp only [hne, ↓reduceIte]
  show (releaseEff d.s b).I l = _; rw [releaseEff_I]

end Thms

/-! ## Marks are never reused (`mark_no_aba`) -/

/-- The marks of the stack `i` are pairwise distinct, name the stack `i` and have identifiers below
`fresh`. -/
def MarksWF (d : DS) : Prop :=
  ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), d.stacks[i]? = some st →
    st.marks.Nodup ∧ ∀ m ∈ st.marks, m.stack = i ∧ m.id < d.fresh

/-- The mark `m` is live in no stack, and its identifier was given out. -/
def Gone (d : DS) (m : Mark) : Prop :=
  m.id < d.fresh ∧ ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), d.stacks[i]? = some st → m ∉ st.marks

theorem marksWF_init : MarksWF DS.init := fun i st h => by simp [DS.init] at h

section ThmsK
variable {k : K} [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] [DecidablePred k.SharedMutable]
  [DecidablePred k.Pinned] [DecidablePred k.ExternalDone] [DecidablePred k.Deallocable]
  [∀ p a, Decidable (k.FreeCompat p a)] [∀ p ls s, Decidable (k.Satisfiable p ls s)]

/-- A step that replaces the stack `j` by a stack with the same marks, or with a part of them,
keeps a property `Q` of the marks read at each index. -/
theorem stacks_set_marks {d : DS} {j : Nat} {st st' : Stack} (hst : d.stacks[j]? = some st)
    {Q : Nat → Mark → Prop}
    (hQ : ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), d.stacks[i]? = some st → ∀ m ∈ st.marks, Q i m) {i : Nat}
    {st'' : Stack} (h : (d.stacks.set j st')[i]? = some st'') (hm : ∀ m ∈ st'.marks, m ∈ st.marks) :
    ∀ m ∈ st''.marks, Q i m := by
  intro m hm'
  rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
  · exact hQ _ st hst m (hm m hm')
  · exact hQ i st'' h m hm'

theorem stacks_set_nodup {d : DS} {j : Nat} {st st' : Stack} (hst : d.stacks[j]? = some st)
    (hw : MarksWF d) {i : Nat} {st'' : Stack} (h : (d.stacks.set j st')[i]? = some st'')
    (hsub : List.Sublist st'.marks st.marks) : st''.marks.Nodup := by
  rcases getElem?_set_cases h with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h⟩
  · exact (hw _ st hst).1.sublist hsub
  · exact (hw i st'' h).1

theorem dexec_gone {d d' : DS} {o : DOp} {m : Mark} (h : dexec k d o = .ok d') (hg : Gone d m) :
    Gone d' m := by
  obtain ⟨hid, hno⟩ := hg
  have hQ : ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), d.stacks[i]? = some st → ∀ m' ∈ st.marks, m' ≠ m :=
    fun i st h m' hm' e => hno i st h (e ▸ hm')
  have fin : ∀ {l : List Stack}, (∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), l[i]? = some st → ∀ m' ∈ st.marks, m' ≠ m) →
      ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), l[i]? = some st → m ∉ st.marks := fun hl i st h hm => hl i st h m hm rfl
  cases o with
  | kernel o =>
    obtain ⟨-, hs, hf⟩ := dexec_kernel h
    exact ⟨by rw [hf]; exact hid, fun i st h' hm => hno i st (by rw [← hs]; exact h') hm⟩
  | newStack st i =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := newStack_ok h
    refine ⟨hid, fun i' st' h' hm => ?_⟩
    rcases getElem?_append_single h' with h' | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact hno i' st' h' hm
    · simp at hm
  | push j size dst =>
    obtain ⟨st, hst, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := push_ok h
    refine ⟨hid, fin ?_⟩
    intro i st'' h' m' hm'; exact stacks_set_marks hst hQ h' (fun _ h => h) m' hm'
  | mark j =>
    obtain ⟨st, hst, rfl⟩ := mark_ok h
    refine ⟨Nat.lt_succ_of_lt hid, fun i st' h' hm => ?_⟩
    rcases getElem?_set_cases h' with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨-, h'⟩
    · rcases List.mem_append.1 hm with hm | hm
      · exact hno _ st hst hm
      · rw [List.mem_singleton] at hm; rw [hm] at hid; exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ hid
    · exact hno i st' h' hm
  | rewind j m' =>
    obtain ⟨st, hst, -, -, rfl⟩ := rewind_ok h
    refine ⟨hid, fin ?_⟩
    intro i st'' h' m' hm'
    exact stacks_set_marks hst hQ h' (fun _ h => List.takeWhile_subset _ h) m' hm'
  | grow j b extra =>
    obtain ⟨st, x, hst, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := grow_ok h
    refine ⟨hid, fin ?_⟩
    intro i st'' h' m' hm'; exact stacks_set_marks hst hQ h' (fun _ h => h) m' hm'

theorem drun_gone {m : Mark} : ∀ {d d' : DS} {os : List DOp}, drun k d os = some d' → Gone d m →
    Gone d' m
  | d, d', [], h, hg => by simp only [drun, Option.some.injEq] at h; subst h; exact hg
  | d, d', o :: os, h, hg => by
    simp only [drun] at h
    split at h
    · rename_i d₁ h₁; exact drun_gone h (dexec_gone h₁ hg)
    · cases h

theorem dexec_marksWF {d d' : DS} {o : DOp} (h : dexec k d o = .ok d') (hw : MarksWF d) :
    MarksWF d' := by
  have hQ : ∀ (i : Nat) (st : Stack), d.stacks[i]? = some st → ∀ m ∈ st.marks,
      m.stack = i ∧ m.id < d.fresh := fun i st h => (hw i st h).2
  cases o with
  | kernel o =>
    obtain ⟨-, hs, hf⟩ := dexec_kernel h
    intro i st h'; rw [hs] at h'; rw [hf]; exact hw i st h'
  | newStack st i =>
    obtain ⟨-, -, rfl⟩ := newStack_ok h
    intro i' st' h'
    rcases getElem?_append_single h' with h' | ⟨-, rfl⟩
    · exact hw i' st' h'
    · exact ⟨List.nodup_nil, fun m hm => by simp at hm⟩
  | push j size dst =>
    obtain ⟨st, hst, -, -, -, rfl⟩ := push_ok h
    intro i st'' h'
    exact ⟨stacks_set_nodup hst hw h' (List.Sublist.refl _),
      stacks_set_marks hst hQ h' (fun _ h => h)⟩
  | mark j =>

/-- Under `MarksWF`, `rewind m` keeps exactly the marks older than `m` and removes `m` and every later
mark of the stack (brief: "`m` et toutes les marques au-dessus sont retirées, les plus anciennes
restent vivantes"). -/
theorem rewind_removes {d d' : DS} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} (hw : MarksWF d)
    (h : rewind k d j m = .ok d') {st : Stack} (hst : d.stacks[j]? = some st)
    {pre post : List Mark} (hs : st.marks = pre ++ m :: post) :
    ∃ st', d'.stacks[j]? = some st' ∧ st'.marks = pre ∧ ∀ m' ∈ m :: post, m' ∉ st'.marks := by
  have hnd := (hw j st hst).1
  rw [hs] at hnd
  have hdisj := (List.nodup_append.1 hnd).2.2
  have hmpre : m ∉ pre := fun h => hdisj m h m (List.mem_cons_self ..) rfl
  obtain ⟨⟨st', hst', hpre, -⟩, -, -⟩ := rewind_keeps_older_marks h hst hs hmpre
  exact ⟨st', hst', hpre, fun m' hm' hin => hdisj m' (hpre ▸ hin) m' hm' rfl⟩

/-- `mark_no_aba` (brief): every mark that `rewind m` removes, `m` and the later marks of the stack,
is live in no stack in any later state, even when the top returns to the same position: identifiers
are fresh and a mark is live by membership, so `rewind` of a removed mark fails forever after. -/
theorem mark_no_aba {d d₁ d' : DS} {j : Nat} {m : Mark} {os : List DOp} (hw : MarksWF d)
    (hr : rewind k d j m = .ok d₁) (h : drun k d₁ os = some d') {st : Stack}
    (hst : d.stacks[j]? = some st) {pre post : List Mark} (hs : st.marks = pre ++ m :: post)
    {m' : Mark} (hm' : m' ∈ m :: post) :
    (∀ (i : Nat) (st' : Stack), d'.stacks[i]? = some st' → m' ∉ st'.marks) ∧
      ∀ st', d'.stacks[j]? = some st' → rewind k d' j m' = .fail := by
  obtain ⟨st₁, hst₁, hgone1, hgone⟩ :
      ∃ st₁, d₁.stacks[j]? = some st₁ ∧ st₁.marks = pre ∧ ∀ m' ∈ m :: post, m' ∉ st₁.marks :=
    rewind_removes hw hr hst hs
  obtain ⟨st₀, hst₀, -, -, rfl⟩ := rewind_ok hr
  rw [hst] at hst₀; cases hst₀
  have hm'st : m' ∈ st.marks := by rw [hs]; exact List.mem_append_right _ hm'
  obtain ⟨-, hwj⟩ := hw j st hst
  have hg : Gone { d with
      s := releaseEff (d.s.addAuth (blockOf d.s st.arena (above st m))) d.s.A.length
      stacks := d.stacks.set j
        { st with
          top := m.top
          blocks := st.blocks.filter (·.base < m.top)
          marks := st.marks.takeWhile (· ≠ m) } } m' := by
    refine ⟨(hwj m' hm'st).2, fun i st' h' hm'' => ?_⟩
    rcases getElem?_set_cases h' with ⟨rfl, rfl⟩ | ⟨hi, h'⟩
    · rw [hst₁] at h'; cases h'; exact hgone m' hm' hm''
    · exact hi (((hw i st' h').2 m' hm'').1.symm.trans (hwj m' hm'st).1)
  have hg' := drun_gone h hg
  refine ⟨hg'.2, fun st' hst' => ?_⟩
  simp [rewind, hst', hg'.2 j st' hst']

/-- Every state reached by the library from `DS.init` has well-formed marks, so `mark_no_aba`
applies to it. -/
theorem drun_init_marksWF {os : List DOp} {d : DS} (h : drun k DS.init os = some d) : MarksWF d :=
  drun_marksWF h marksWF_init

/-! ## Cases (brief, question 2)

Runs from `DS.init` under the test contracts `K0`; each statement includes that the run is `ok`
(`isSome`), so that `final` is its state; every verdict by `decide`. -/

def Out.isOk : Out → Bool
  | .ok _ => true
  | _ => false

def Out.isFail : Out → Bool
  | .fail => true
  | _ => false

def Out.isReject : Out → Bool
  | .reject => true
  | _ => false

/-- The state of a run from `DS.init` (`DS.init` when a step is not `ok`). -/
def final (os : List DOp) : DS := (drun K0 DS.init os).getD DS.init

/-- The kernel state of an `ok` run of the library is reached. -/
theorem final_reach {os : List DOp} (h : (drun K0 DS.init os).isSome = true) :
    Reachable K0 [] (final os).s := by
  obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.1 h
  have := drun_reach (statics := []) (show Reachable K0 [] DS.init.s from .init (by decide)) hd
  simp only [final, hd, Option.getD_some]; exact this

/-- A cell of the storage `p`. -/
abbrev cellOf (p : Nat) : Option Nat × Option Nat × Nat := (some p, none, 0)

/-- One stack: frame 1 with the leaves 0 (stack value), 2, 3, 4 (cells of the storage 1), 5, 6, 7
(destinations), of root authorities 0 (on 0), 1 (on 1), 2, 3, 4 (on 5, 6, 7); `internal` 5 derived
from 1 and stored into 0; the stack 0 created on 1 with `internal` 5. -/
def setup1 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, lf, lf, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 1 .modify), .kernel (.store 5 0), .newStack 1 5]

/-- Mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩`, `push 2` into 5 (block 6 on `[2, 3]`), mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩`, `push 1` into 6
(block 7 on `[4]`). -/
def opsR : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .push 0 1 6]

/-- **`rewind` refused then accepted**: `rewind ⟨0, 1, 2⟩` is rejected while the block 7, derived
from `internal`, covers the cell 4 above the mark (`rewind_rejects_live_above`); after the release
of 7 it is accepted: the top returns to 2, the mark `⟨0, 0, 0⟩` stays, the block 6 stays. -/
theorem case_rewind :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsR).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsR) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩])).stacks.map
      (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) = [(2, [⟨0, 2, 6, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩])] := by
  decide

/-- The run of `case_rewind`, then a new mark: it has the top 2 of the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩` and
the fresh identifier 2. -/
def opsA : List DOp := opsR ++ [.kernel (.release 7), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩, .mark 0]

/-- **ABA** (`mark_no_aba`): the top is back at 2, the position of the removed mark `⟨0, 1, 2⟩`,
and a mark `⟨0, 2, 2⟩` is live there; `rewind ⟨0, 1, 2⟩` fails, `rewind ⟨0, 2, 2⟩` is accepted. -/
theorem case_aba :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsA).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsA).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.marks)) = [(2, [⟨0, 0, 0⟩, ⟨0, 2, 2⟩])] ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsA) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 2⟩)).isFail = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsA) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 2, 2⟩)).isOk = true := by
  decide

/-- The run of `case_aba`, then `grow` of the last block 6 by one cell. -/
def opsG : List DOp := opsA ++ [.grow 0 6 1]

/-- **`grow`**: `grow 6 1` is accepted in place: the last block becomes `⟨0, 3, 9, 5⟩`, of the same
base and destination, and its authority 9 covers `[2, 3, 4]`; `grow 9 1` then fails, no cell
following; `grow 6 1` is rejected, 6 being no longer the last block. -/
theorem case_grow :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsG).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsG).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks)) = [(3, [⟨0, 3, 9, 5⟩])] ∧
    (final opsG).s.afp 9 = [2, 3, 4] ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsG) (.grow 0 9 1)).isFail = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsG) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true := by
  decide

/-- Two stacks: frame 1 with the leaves 0 and 8 (stack values), the storages 1 (cells 2, 3, 4)
and 9 (cells 10, 11), the destinations 5, 6, 7, 12, of root authorities 0 to 7; `internal` 8 on 1
stored into 0, stack 0; `internal` 9 on 9 stored into 8, stack 1. -/
def setup2 : List DOp :=
  [.kernel (.enter [] [lf, lf, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, cellOf 1, lf, lf, lf, lf, lf, cellOf 9, cellOf 9, lf]),
    .kernel (.derive 1 1 .modify), .kernel (.store 8 0), .newStack 1 8,
    .kernel (.derive 6 9 .modify), .kernel (.store 9 8), .newStack 9 9]

def opsS : List DOp := setup2 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .push 1 1 12, .mark 1]

/-- **Several stacks**: the guard of §56 rejects a second stack with `internal` 8, and a kernel
`newArena` with `internal` 8, which the kernel alone accepts; each stack has its top, blocks and
marks; `rewind` of stack 0 to its mark is rejected while its block 10 lives, a mark of stack 1 is not
a live mark of stack 0 (`fail`), stack 1 rewinds to its mark and pushes again. -/
theorem case_stacks :
    (drun K0 DS.init setup2).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup2) (.newStack 1 8)).isReject = true ∧
    (kexec K0 (final setup2).s (.newArena 1 8)).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup2) (.kernel (.newArena 1 8))).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsS).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsS).stacks.map (fun st => (st.internal, st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) =
      [(8, 1, [⟨0, 1, 10, 5⟩], [⟨0, 0, 0⟩]), (9, 1, [⟨0, 1, 11, 12⟩], [⟨1, 1, 1⟩])] ∧

    (dexec K0 (final opsS) (.rewind 0 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩)).isFail = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsS ++ [.rewind 1 ⟨1, 1, 1⟩, .push 1 1 6])).isSome = true := by

releases the block, `rewind` to the entry mark and `exitFrame` are accepted, and the stack is empty

  setup1 ++ [.kernel (.derive 0 0 .modify), .kernel (.enter [6] [lf]), .mark 0, .push 0 2 8]

theorem case_frame :
    (drun K0 DS.init opsF).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsF) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsF ++ [.kernel (.endUse 8), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .kernel .exit])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsF ++ [.kernel (.endUse 8), .rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩, .kernel .exit])).stacks.map
      (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) = [(0, [], [])] := by
  decide

/-- Block 6 pushed on `[2, 3]`, mark `⟨0, 0, 2⟩`, block grown to `[2, 3, 4]` (authority 7), released;

  setup1 ++ [.push 0 2 5, .mark 0, .grow 0 6 1, .kernel (.release 7), .kernel (.derive 5 2 .modify)]

def opsE8 : List DOp :=
  setup1 ++ [.mark 0, .push 0 1 5, .mark 0, .push 0 1 6, .kernel (.release 7),
    .rewind 0 ⟨0, 1, 1⟩, .kernel (.release 6), .kernel (.derive 5 3 .modify)]

/-- **Reading of "couvre une région émise après `m`"** (review, DS-2 and DS-3): `rewind` looks at

    (dexec K0 (final opsE4) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 2⟩)).isOk = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsE8).isSome = true ∧
    (final opsE8).s.A[9]?.map (fun y => (y.active, y.origin, y.footprint)) = some (true, some 5, [3]) ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsE8) (.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩)).isOk = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).isSome = true ∧
    (final (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).s.A[6]?.map (fun y => (y.active, y.origin, y.footprint)) =
      some (true, some 5, []) ∧
    (final (opsE3 ++ [.rewind 0 ⟨0, 0, 0⟩])).stacks.map (fun st => (st.top, st.blocks, st.marks)) =
      [(0, [], [])] := by
  decide

/-- Block 6 pushed into 5, then a callee entered with only 7, a `Modify` derived from the root of 5:
it has no right on the stack value 0. -/
def opsZ : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.push 0 1 5, .kernel (.derive 2 5 .modify), .kernel (.enter [7] [])]

def opsIn : List DOp := setup1 ++ [.push 0 1 3]

/-- **Static clauses before `fail`** (§58, §77.4; review, DS-5 and Q2-GROW-ORDER): without a right on
the stack value, `grow` is rejected with or without room; `push` into an `Init` destination is
rejected, with or without room; `push` into a destination inside the requested cells is rejected
even without room, while the same `push` into an outside destination fails; `grow` into a recorded
destination inside the new region is rejected even without room (`opsIn`). -/

    (drun K0 DS.init opsZ).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsZ) (.grow 0 6 5)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsZ) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init (setup1 ++ [.kernel (.write 2 [5])])).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final (setup1 ++ [.kernel (.write 2 [5])])) (.push 0 1 5)).isReject = true ∧

    (dexec K0 (final setup1) (.push 0 4 2)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final setup1) (.push 0 4 5)).isFail = true ∧
    (drun K0 DS.init opsIn).isSome = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsIn) (.grow 0 6 1)).isReject = true ∧
    (dexec K0 (final opsIn) (.grow 0 6 5)).isReject = true := by

## (c) Écarts dans les deux sens

| 2 | la séquence accepte, `issue` rejette | §77.2 (« non `Init` ») contre O8.2 (« Le fait que ses données soient déjà `Init` n'interdit pas à lui seul l'opération ») | `ce_init` | spécification |

| 6 | `issue` accepte, `derive` ne peut pas | région qui n'est l'empreinte d'aucun emplacement, région vide comprise : le `derive` du noyau prend un emplacement | `ce_empty_region` | noyau (représentation) ; `split` à une région couvre le cas |

Détail de l'écart 1 (`ce_g2`) :

- **Construction.** Une autorité 5, dérivée de la racine de la destination 2, est rangée dans la feuille de stockage 1. La destination n'est alors exerçable en `Modify` que par 5, donc par `internal` sur 1.
- **Issue.** `IssueR` et l'`issue` du noyau sont `ok` pour la région `[1]` vers 2.
- **Arrivée.** Le bloc sur 1, détenu par 2, et 5, détenu par 1, se bloquent mutuellement ; 2 n'est plus exerçable.
- **Séquence.** `split` est `ok` ; `store` est rejeté par O8.5.

C'est un blocage indirect que §88 admet (« des blocages indirects compatibles avec la sûreté peuvent subsister »). Option 2 (destination hors région) et O8.3 coïncident ; seul O8.5 sépare.

Détail de l'écart 8 (`ce_avail_leaf`). Après l'émission de `[5]`, bloc actif :

- **Lecture du noyau** (feuille par feuille). La région `[5, 6]`, qui chevauche l'émission en partie, est indisponible : `issue` échoue (`fail`, §77.4).
- **Lecture « ensemble de régions »** (§46). Seule `[5]` quitte `available`, donc `[5, 6]` resterait disponible et §77.5 la rejetterait (`reject`), `internal` n'ayant plus le droit effectif sur 5.
- **Conséquences de la lecture du noyau.** La phrase de §77.5 « La région ne peut chevaucher une région émise encore active » n'est jamais atteinte dans un état atteint. La région vide est toujours disponible.

L'équivalence de (a) vaut pour l'une ou l'autre lecture : la disponibilité n'y figure que comme hypothèse sur les métadonnées.

## (d) Statut des théorèmes de `DataStack`

`DataStack` est une instance de bibliothèque. Son état contient l'état du noyau, les piles (stockage, `internal`, cellules ordonnées, sommet, blocs émis, marques vivantes) et le prochain identifiant de marque. Ses opérations n'effectuent que des pas du noyau :

| Opération | Pas du noyau | Issues |
|---|---|---|
| `push` | clauses statiques de l'`issue` restreint (§77.1, §77.2) avant la place, puis `split` et `store` | `fail` sans place |
| `rewind` | `split` puis `release` (`reset` dérivé) sur les cellules au-dessus de la marque | `fail` pour une marque non vivante de la pile |
| `grow` | clauses statiques (dont `MetaRightM` et la destination hors de la nouvelle région) avant la place, puis `release` du dernier bloc et `issue` dérivé de même base et de taille plus grande vers la destination enregistrée (`Init`, ou `Moved` après un `transfer`) | `fail` sans place |
| `mark` | aucun (métadonnées) | `ok` sur une pile existante |
| `newStack` | aucun (inscription) | garde de §56 sur les deux registres |

Un `newArena` du noyau consulte aussi le registre des piles (`KGuard`, §56). Tout pas `ok` de la bibliothèque est une suite de pas de `Reachable` (`dexec_reach`, `drun_reach`).

| Théorème | Statut | Énoncé |
|---|---|---|

| `mark_no_aba` | prouvé | **toute** marque retirée par `rewind m` (`m` et les marques postérieures de la pile) n'est plus vivante dans aucune pile après toute suite d'opérations, et son `rewind` échoue (`fail`), même quand le sommet revient à sa position. Hypothèse `MarksWF` (marques deux à deux distinctes, nommant leur pile, d'identifiants donnés), établie pour tout état atteint par la bibliothèque (`drun_init_marksWF`) |
| `rewind_removes` | prouvé | sous `MarksWF` : après `rewind m`, les marques de la pile sont exactement celles antérieures à `m` ; `m` et les postérieures sont retirées |
| `rewind_keeps_older_marks` | prouvé | après `rewind m` : marques = celles antérieures à `m`, sommet = sommet de `m`, autres piles inchangées, initialisation inchangée |
| `grow_same_base` | prouvé | dernier bloc de même base, de taille `size + extra`, de même destination enregistrée ; dans l'état d'arrivée, l'autorité nouvelle couvre les cellules depuis la même base et est détenue par cette destination, et l'ancien bloc est inactif ; anciennes cellules préfixe des nouvelles |
| `grow_keeps_prefix_init` | prouvé | aucune cellule de l'ancien bloc ne change d'initialisation |
| `grow_keeps_prefix_bytes` | prouvé, via `Ern.MM23` inchangé | voir ci-dessous |

Détail de `grow_keeps_prefix_bytes`. `release` et `split` sont des pas sans pas MM-02 (`NoStep`, K4, dont `r6_noStep` conserve `Repr`). `store` correspond à une écriture de la plage de la destination (`storeOps`, L6). Pour toute disposition `LayoutWF`, cette écriture laisse inchangés les octets **et provenances** (`rangeBytes`) de chaque cellule de l'ancien bloc.

Cas (`decide`, chaque exécution étant d'abord établie `ok`) :

| Cas | Théorème | Contenu |
|---|---|---|

| `rewind` refusé puis accepté | `case_rewind` | refusé tant que le bloc 7 vit, accepté après sa libération |
| ABA | `case_aba` | sommet revenu à 2 ; la marque retirée `⟨0, 1, 2⟩` échoue ; la nouvelle `⟨0, 2, 2⟩` est acceptée |
| `grow` | `case_grow` | accepté en place ; sans place : `fail` ; bloc qui n'est plus le dernier : `reject` |
| cadre | `case_frame` | marque à l'entrée de l'appelé, `push` dans un local ; `rewind` refusé tant que le bloc vit ; après `endUse` du local, `rewind` et `exitFrame` acceptés, pile vide |
| lecture de `rewind` | `case_rewind_reading` | une autorité dérivée active couvrant la partie d'une région émise après `m` qui est sous `m` (bloc agrandi) ou au-dessus du sommet courant ne bloque pas `rewind` ; un bloc vide (`push` de taille 0) non plus, et les métadonnées l'oublient alors qu'il reste actif |
| statique avant `fail` | `case_static_before_fail` | sans droit sur la valeur pile, `grow` est rejeté avec ou sans place ; `push` vers une destination `Init` est rejeté avec ou sans place ; `push` vers une destination intérieure aux cellules demandées, et `grow` vers une destination enregistrée intérieure à la nouvelle région, sont rejetés même sans place |
| atteignabilité | `cases_reachable` | les états noyau des cas sont atteints |

Constats utiles pour la question 1 :

- **`grow` et `Init`.** Sans `transfer` du bloc, `grow` réémet dans une destination déjà `Init`, celle du bloc libéré. Il n'est alors exprimable qu'avec l'`issue` dérivé, `store` acceptant une cible `Init` ; `IssueR` le rejetterait (écart 2). Après un `transfer`, la destination enregistrée est `Moved`, et `IssueR` l'accepterait.
- **`push` et l'`issue` restreint.** `push`, que la tâche définit par l'`issue` restreint, en suit les clauses statiques. Réalisé par `split` et `store`, il demande aussi O8.5 (écart 1). Sa relation exacte à `IssueR` n'est pas prouvée : `issue_as_kernel_split` porte sur une entrée du registre d'arènes, ce qu'une pile n'est pas, et la place y tient lieu de disponibilité.

## (f) Questions et décisions non dictées

### Questions pour arbitrage

1. **§78.3.** Lecture inclusive ou stricte du « sous-arbre d'origines de `internal` » ? Voir (e) 4 et l'exemple `ce_reset_anchor`. Ce passage est ambigu au sens d'`AGENTS.md`. La formalisation reprend la lecture du noyau sans la trancher.
2. **§46 et §77.4 (disponibilité).** Lecture par feuilles (celle du noyau, reprise ici) ou par régions ? Voir (e) 6 et `ce_avail_leaf` : les deux lectures classent différemment une région qui chevauche en partie une émission active (`fail` ou `reject`).
3. **§77.2 contre O8.2 (`Init`)** et **§77.6 contre O8.5 (exerçabilité d'arrivée)** : quelle formulation, (A) ou (B), de (e) 2 et (e) 3 ?
4. **§78.2 et l'empreinte vide** : (e) 5, (A) ou (B) ?
5. **§56** : la garde reste-t-elle une règle de la spécification, au titre du contrat de l'abstraction, puisque aucune propriété de sûreté n'en dépend (`newArena_as_library`, `ce_two_admins_ok`) ?
6. **`DataStack.push` et `grow`.** La tâche définit `push` par l'`issue` restreint, et `grow` par une émission de même base, sans dire laquelle. C'est un choix sémantique : il change les programmes acceptés.
   - `push` suit ici les clauses statiques de l'`issue` restreint : destination non `Init`, hors des cellules demandées, droit sur la valeur pile, tous contrôlés avant la place.
   - `grow` utilise l'`issue` dérivé. Sa destination est `Init` tant que le bloc n'a pas été transféré, et l'`issue` restreint la rejetterait alors ; après un `transfer`, elle est `Moved` et l'`issue` restreint l'accepterait.
   - Si la formulation (A) de (e) 2 est retenue, la clause `Init` cesse de séparer les deux ; O8.5 les sépare encore, sauf si (e) 3 (A) est aussi retenu.
7. **`DataStack.rewind`.** « Couvre une région émise après `m` » est lu sur les cellules que `rewind` rend (`above`, du sommet de `m` au sommet courant). Ce n'est pas exactement « les régions émises après `m` » (`case_rewind_reading`) :
   - un bloc agrandi après `m` commence sous `m`, et une dérivation active sur sa partie basse ne bloque pas `rewind` ;
   - une région émise après `m` puis rendue par un `rewind` intermédiaire est au-dessus du sommet courant ;
   - un bloc vide émis après `m` ne bloque pas `rewind`.

   Aucun de ces cas ne rend disponible une cellule couverte. Une lecture « couvre la région entière » laisserait `rewind` passer quand une dérivation en couvre une partie seulement ; le `push` suivant serait alors rejeté par le droit effectif (§43, cas 3). Quelle lecture est voulue ?

### Décisions de représentation prises ici (à confirmer)

- **`IssueR` suit le texte candidat** : destination hors région, ancre ajoutée à `D(dst)`. L'`issue` du noyau en diffère (écart 7). L'équivalence est donc établie pour le texte candidat ; pour l'`issue` du noyau, l'option 2 manque (`H50_options`, jalon 3).
- **Lecture inclusive de §78.3 pour `ResetPreR`**, celle du noyau ((f) 1). **Lecture par feuilles de la disponibilité**, celle du noyau ((f) 2).
- **Clauses statiques avant `fail`** (§58), par analogie avec §77 :
  - `push` : clauses de `IssueStaticR` (pile vivante, `MetaRightM`, destination feuille utilisable, sous `Modify`, non `Init`, sans autorité active, hors des cellules) ;
  - `grow` : `0 < extra`, `b` dernier bloc et au sommet, `b` libérable, pile vivante, `MetaRightM`, destination enregistrée hors de la nouvelle région. Les autres clauses sur la destination portent sur l'état après la libération ; ce sont celles de `store`.

  La tâche dit seulement « `fail` si pas de place ». La place tient lieu à la fois de l'inclusion de la région dans le stockage (clause statique de §77.2) et de sa disponibilité (§77.4). `0 < extra` traduit « taille plus grande ».
- **`push` de taille 0** est accepté, comme l'`issue` restreint de la région vide (`ce_empty_region`). Le bloc vide ne bloque aucun `rewind` (`case_rewind_reading`).
- **`grow` stocke dans la destination enregistrée** pour le bloc (`Blk.dst`), qui peut ne plus être le détenteur du bloc après un `transfer` (cible `Moved`, permise par §77.2).
- **`mark` n'exige aucun droit**, la tâche disant « `mark : ok` ». Il ne modifie que des métadonnées. Une pile inexistante donne `reject`.
- **`rewind`** :
  - les blocs conservés sont ceux dont la base est sous le sommet de `m` ; un bloc agrandi qui chevauche ce sommet est conservé, et il est nécessairement inactif ;
  - une marque est vivante par appartenance à la liste de la pile ;
  - une pile inexistante donne `reject`.
- **Garde de §56 de `newStack`** : les arènes du noyau et les piles. Les pools de `HandlePool` ne sont pas combinés ici.

## Revue adverse

Méthode : quatre relecteurs indépendants, en lecture seule :
- `issue` ;
- `reset`, `newArena` et `writeShared` ;
- `DataStack` : marques et `rewind` ;
- `DataStack` : `grow`, octets, atteignabilité et cas.

Chacun est suivi d'un vérificateur chargé de réfuter ses constats en les reproduisant (exécutions `#eval` et `decide` sur des états atteints, fichiers de travail hors dépôt). Sur 16 constats, 12 sont confirmés (1 bloquant, 1 majeur, 10 mineurs) et 4 réfutés.

Les relecteurs n'ont trouvé aucun écart supplémentaire entre l'opération et la séquence. Les équivalences sont des `iff` vérifiés par la machine : dans un état atteint, seuls O8.5, la disponibilité et `Init` séparent `IssueR` de la séquence.

### Revue ciblée des corrections

Trois relecteurs, chacun suivi d'un vérificateur, ont porté sur les corrections de `DataStack`, celles de `Derived.Arena` et la cohérence de ce rapport avec le code. Sur 20 constats, 17 sont confirmés (1 majeur, 16 mineurs) et 3 réfutés.

- **Corrections de `DataStack` : tenues.**
  - `MarksWF` est satisfaisable et préservée.
  - `mark_no_aba` couvre toute marque retirée.
  - Le contrôle de build, de mots interdits et d'axiomes est propre.
- **Constat majeur (R-1).** Ce rapport attribuait à la garde de §56 un seul effet, `reject` au lieu de `fail`. Une seconde administration peut aussi rendre `ok` une émission que la première ferait échouer (`ce_two_admins_ok`, ajouté). (a) et (e) 7 sont corrigés : la garde protège le contrat de l'abstraction, aucune propriété de sûreté.
- **Code.**
  - `grow` contrôle désormais aussi « destination hors de la nouvelle région » avant `fail` (§77.2, `case_static_before_fail`).
  - Les docstrings de `push` et `grow` ne prétendent plus ce qui n'est pas prouvé : relation exacte de `push` à `IssueR` ; destination `Init` ou `Moved` après `transfer`.
  - `case_rewind_reading` vérifie que les métadonnées oublient le bloc vide.
  - L'attribution à I1 de la double émission est corrigée : c'est le droit effectif, §43 cas 3.
- **Rapport.**
  - (e) 2 (A) et (f) 6 : la coïncidence exige aussi (e) 3 (A).
  - (e) 1 : citation exacte de §36, et portée sur les pools.
  - (e) 7 : la consultation des deux registres est déjà exigée par le texte.
  - (e) 8 : §38 ajouté.
  - Liste des passages lus et formalisés corrigée.
  - Tableaux de (d) corrigés (« contraposée », `mark` sur une pile existante, cas statiques).
- **Réfutés.**
  - Le conjoint « anciennes cellules préfixe des nouvelles » de `grow_same_base` vaut pour toute pile. Le vérificateur le juge exact : la docstring le décrit comme une propriété des métadonnées (`cellsOf`), et les autres conjoints portent sur l'état d'arrivée.
  - `ce_avail_leaf` et `resetAtPreR_iff` sans docstring propre. Ce sont un cas et un lemme de dépliage ; les passages sont cités par `opsLeaf` et `ResetAtPreR`.

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Preserve.Common

/-!
# Arenas: the reference library abstraction (Part XIV)

Arenas of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md`, Part XIV (§76–§78), with §36, §46, §55,
§56, §58, §79, §86 and §88. An arena is a library abstraction (Part XIV): its entries live in a
library state separate from the kernel state `S₃` (§38, §46). `newArena` (O17) only registers an
entry; `issue` (O18) and `reset` (O19) are defined twice:

* as their contracts, clause by clause (§77, §78): `IssueC`, `ResetC`;
* as derived operations over the kernel steps (Part XIV): `issue` is its static checks, the
  availability `fail`, then `split` of `internal` on the region and `store` of the block into the
  destination (`IssueD`); `reset` is `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the whole storage,
  then `release`, then the explicit check of §78.3 (`ResetD`).

`issue_as_kernel` and `reset_as_kernel` show that both definitions have the same outcomes and the
same arrival states. Library reachability (`LReach`, `LReachNG`) uses the derived operations, so
its kernel states are kernel-reachable (`newArena_as_library`).
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Arena

open Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-! ## Library state (§46) -/

/-- Arena entry (§46): administered storage, `internal` authority, available leaves and issued
regions with their block authorities. The sets of §46 are lists read by membership. -/
structure ArenaEntry where
  storage : Nat
  internal : Nat
  available : List Nat
  issued : List (List Nat × Nat)
deriving DecidableEq, Repr

/-- Library state (§46, §38): the kernel state `S₃` and, separately, the arena registry. -/
structure LState where
  kern : S3
  arenas : List ArenaEntry

/-- Initial library state (§47): the initial kernel state and an empty arena registry. -/
def LState.init (statics : Statics) : LState := ⟨S3.init statics, []⟩

/-- Live arena (§46): `internal` is active. -/
def Live (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := s.Active E.internal

/-- Decidability of `Live` (§46). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (Live s E) :=
  inferInstanceAs (Decidable (s.Active _))

/-- Arena value (§46): the place holding `internal`. -/
def arenaValue (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Option Nat :=
  match s.A[E.internal]? with
  | some y => match y.holder with
    | .place v => some v
    | .frame _ => none
  | none => none

/-- `MetaRight(s, arena)` (§36, §77.1, §78.1): exercisable `Modify` over the arena value; there is
no `writeShared` branch. -/
def MetaRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  OptP (arenaValue s E) (fun v => HasRight s .modify v) False

/-- Decidability of `MetaRight` (§36). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (MetaRight s E) := by
  unfold MetaRight; infer_instance

/-- Available region (§46): each of its leaves belongs to `available`; the empty region is always
available. -/
def Avail (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop := ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ E.available

/-- Decidability of `Avail` (§46). -/
instance (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (Avail E region) := by
  unfold Avail; infer_instance

/-! ## `ArenaInv` (§55) -/

/-- `ArenaInv` (§55), required for live arenas. "Still-issued" is read as "with an active block
authority". The clause "anchor and ownership restrictions are respected" has no referent and is
not represented; "complying with exclusivity and validity rules" is left to the kernel
invariants (§57). -/
structure ArenaInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §55, item 1: `storage` designates an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable E.storage
  /-- §55, item 1: the footprint of `internal` is exactly the footprint of `storage`. -/
  fpEq : ∀ l, l ∈ s.afp E.internal ↔ l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` is active. -/
  active : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §55, item 2: `internal` has own mode `Modify` and is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  shape : OptP (s.A[E.internal]?) (fun y => y.mode = .modify ∧ y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §55, item 3: available leaves belong to the administered storage. -/
  availableIn : ∀ l ∈ E.available, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 3: issued regions belong to the administered storage. -/
  issuedIn : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §55, item 4: two still-active issuances have disjoint regions. -/
  disjoint : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∀ e' ∈ E.issued, e ≠ e' → s.Active e.2 → s.Active e'.2 →
    ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ e'.1
  /-- §55, item 4: no leaf of a still-issued region belongs to `available`. -/
  notAvailable : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → ∀ l ∈ e.1, l ∉ E.available
  /-- §55, item 5: every still-issued block authority is a derivative of `internal`. -/
  derived : ∀ e ∈ E.issued, s.Active e.2 → E.internal ∈ s.ancs e.2

/-- Shape of the issued blocks (support for §55, item 5, from the `ok` effect of §77; not a clause
of `ArenaInv`): every issued block authority exists, has direct origin `internal`, a fresh identity
above it, its region as footprint and mode `Modify`. -/
def IssuedShape (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ e ∈ E.issued, ∃ y, s.A[e.2]? = some y ∧ y.origin = some E.internal ∧ E.internal < e.2 ∧
    y.footprint = e.1 ∧ y.mode = .modify

/-- The per-entry library invariant (§55): `ArenaInv` and the auxiliary `IssuedShape`. -/
def EntryInv (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop := ArenaInv s E ∧ IssuedShape s E

/-- The library invariant (§55, §46): every registered `internal` exists, and every live entry
satisfies `EntryInv`. -/
def LInv (L : LState) : Prop :=
  ∀ E ∈ L.arenas, E.internal < L.kern.A.length ∧ (Live L.kern E → EntryInv L.kern E)

/-! ## O17 `newArena` (§76) and the guard of §56 -/

/-- All leaves of the place holding an authority are `Init` (§76.5); vacuous for a frame. -/
def LeavesInit (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .place v => ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P v, s.I l = .init
  | .frame _ => True

/-- Decidability of `LeavesInit` (§76.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (LeavesInit s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold LeavesInit <;> infer_instance

/-- The unified administration guard (§56, §76.4) as a contract predicate: `internal` is absent
from every registry of live administrations. A registry is given by the `internal` identities of
its live administrations; `regs` lists all relevant registries. -/
def Guard56 (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Prop := ∀ R ∈ regs, i ∉ R

/-- Decidability of `Guard56` (§56). -/
instance (regs : List (List Nat)) (i : Nat) : Decidable (Guard56 regs i) := by
  unfold Guard56; infer_instance

/-- The arena registry as a registry of live administrations (§46, §56): the `internal`
identities of its live entries. -/
def liveInternals (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) : List Nat :=
  (arenas.filter fun E => decide (s.Active E.internal)).map (·.internal)

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` other than the guard (§76.1–§76.3, §76.5).
§76.6 restates invariants and is not a precondition (`newArena_clause6`). -/
structure NewArenaBase (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is an existing, usable place. -/
  storageUsable : s.Usable storage
  /-- §76.1: `storage` is under exercisable `Modify` by the current frame. -/
  storageRight : HasRight s .modify storage
  /-- §76.2: `internal` exists, is active and has own mode `Modify`. -/
  internalAuth : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False
  /-- §76.2: `ExercisableAt(s, internal, Modify)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt internal .modify
  /-- §76.3: `internal` is held by a place, the arena value. -/
  heldByPlace : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(internal) ⊆ footprint(storage)`. -/
  fpSub : ∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage
  /-- §76.3: `footprint(storage) ⊆ footprint(internal)`. -/
  fpSup : ∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal
  /-- §76.5: all leaves of the arena value are already `Init`. -/
  valueInit : OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaBase` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (storage internal : Nat) : Decidable (NewArenaBase s storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Usable storage ∧ HasRight s .modify storage ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ y.mode = .modify) False ∧
    s.ExercisableAt internal .modify ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => y.holder.isPlace = true) False ∧
    (∀ l ∈ s.afp internal, l ∈ footprint s.P storage) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ footprint s.P storage, l ∈ s.afp internal) ∧
    OptP (s.A[internal]?) (fun y => LeavesInit s y.holder) True)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- Preconditions of `newArena(storage, internal)` (§76): those of `NewArenaBase` and the guard of
§76.4 over the arena registry and the other registries `others` (§56). -/
structure NewArenaPre (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat))
    (storage internal : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §76.1–§76.3, §76.5. -/
  base : NewArenaBase s storage internal
  /-- §76.4, §56: no live administration of any relevant registry uses `internal`. -/
  guard : Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal

/-- Decidability of `NewArenaPre` (§76). -/
instance (s : S3) (arenas : List ArenaEntry) (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) :
    Decidable (NewArenaPre s arenas others storage internal) :=
  decidable_of_iff (NewArenaBase s storage internal ∧
    Guard56 (liveInternals s arenas :: others) internal)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩, fun ⟨a, b⟩ => ⟨a, b⟩⟩

/-- Effect of `newArena` (§76, `ok` effect): a live entry is added, `available` holding the leaves
of the storage and `issued` empty; the kernel state is unchanged. -/
def newArenaEff (L : LState) (storage internal : Nat) : LState :=
  { L with arenas := L.arenas ++ [⟨storage, internal, footprint L.kern.P storage, []⟩] }

/-- `newArena` as a relation (§76, §58): `ok` or `reject`; `others` are the other registries of
live administrations consulted by the guard (§56). -/
def NewArenaStep (others : List (List Nat)) (storage internal : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop :=
  Guarded (NewArenaPre L.kern L.arenas others storage internal) (newArenaEff L storage internal)

/-! ## O18 `issue` (§77) -/

/-- Static preconditions of `issue(arena, region, destination)` (§77.1, §77.2). The static
restrictions of §77.3 are given no list by the text and are not represented. -/
structure IssueStatic (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.1: the entry is live; `internal` is active. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §77.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §77.2: `region` belongs to the administered storage. -/
  regionIn : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is usable. -/
  dstUsable : s.Usable dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` is a leaf. -/
  dstLeaf : isLeaf s.P dst
  /-- §77.2: `destination` holds no active authority. -/
  dstFree : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
    OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True
  /-- §77.2: `destination` can legally receive the block value in mode `Modify`. -/
  dstRight : HasRight s .modify dst
  /-- §77.2: local self-blocking prevention, `destination` is not in `region`. -/
  dstNotIn : dst ∉ region

/-- Decidability of `IssueStatic` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueStatic s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ s.Usable dst ∧ isLeaf s.P dst ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length,
      OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun z => z.active = true → z.holder ≠ .place dst) True) ∧
    HasRight s .modify dst ∧ dst ∉ region)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h⟩⟩

/-- §77.5: the effective mode of `internal` permits `Modify` on every leaf of the region. -/
def IssueRight (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Prop :=
  ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s E.internal l) .modify

/-- Decidability of `IssueRight` (§77.5). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : Decidable (IssueRight s E region) := by
  unfold IssueRight; infer_instance

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect): a block authority of fresh identity
`|A|`, derived from `internal`, of mode `Modify`, on the region, held by `destination`, which
receives the corresponding anchor; only leaf `destination` becomes `Init`. -/
def issueKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : S3 :=
  { s with
    A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, region, .place dst, true⟩]
    D := fun q => if q = dst then s.D dst ++ [s.A.length] else s.D q
    I := fun l => if l = dst then .init else s.I l }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `issue` (§77, `ok` effect; §46): the leaves of the region leave
`available`; the issuance joins `issued` with its authority. -/
def issueMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with
    available := E.available.filter fun l => decide (l ∉ region)
    issued := (region, s.A.length) :: E.issued }

/-- Checks of `issue` on the simulated resulting state (§77.3, §77.6). -/
structure IssueArrival (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §77.3: `AnchorOrder` for the new anchor of `destination`, in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrder : EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
    ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst)
  /-- §77.6: `AnchorOrderHeld` in the resulting state. -/
  anchorOrderHeld : AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst)
  /-- §77.6, O8.5: `destination` remains under exercisable `Modify` in the resulting state. -/
  keepsDst : HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst

/-- Decidability of `IssueArrival` (§77). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) :
    Decidable (IssueArrival s E region dst) :=
  decidable_of_iff (EffAnchorOK (issueKEff s E region dst) s.A.length
      ((issueKEff s E region dst).pframe dst) ∧ AnchorOrderHeld (issueKEff s E region dst) ∧
    HasRight (issueKEff s E region dst) .modify dst)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c⟩ => ⟨a, b, c⟩⟩

/-- Library state after an `ok` issue of entry `i` (§77, `ok` effect). -/
def issueL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) : LState :=
  ⟨issueKEff L.kern E region dst, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩

/-- The contract of `issue` on entry `i` (§77, §58): `reject` when the entry is missing or a
static precondition fails; `fail`, the state unchanged, when the region is unavailable (§77.4);
`reject` when the effective right (§77.5) or a check on the resulting state (§77.3, §77.6)
fails; `ok` otherwise. -/
inductive IssueC (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueC i region dst L .fail
  | noRight {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → ¬ IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | noArrival {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → ¬ IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → IssueRight L.kern E region → IssueArrival L.kern E region dst →
      IssueC i region dst L (.ok (issueL L i E region dst))

/-- `issue` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §77): its static checks, then the availability
`fail` (§77.4), then `split` of `internal` on the region (O2) and `store` of the block, of fresh
identity `|A|`, into the destination (O8); the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive IssueD (k : K) (i : Nat) (region : List Nat) (dst : Nat) (L : LState) :
    Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | static {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | fail {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      ¬ Avail E region → IssueD k i region dst L .fail
  | split {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern .reject →
      IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | store {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → IssueStatic L.kern E region dst →
      Avail E region → SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ .reject → IssueD k i region dst L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      IssueStatic L.kern E region dst → Avail E region →
      SplitStep k E.internal [region] L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      StoreStep L.kern.A.length dst s₁ (.ok s₂) →
      IssueD k i region dst L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (issueMeta L.kern E region)⟩)

/-! ## O19 `reset` (§78) -/

/-- §78.3: no still-usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of
`internal`. Dependencies of contained values are covered since parts are places. -/
def ResetNoDeps (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop :=
  ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → ∀ x ∈ s.D q, E.internal ∉ s.ancs x

/-- Decidability of `ResetNoDeps` (§78.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetNoDeps s E) := by
  unfold ResetNoDeps; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `reset(arena)` (§78). "`internal` and the arena's other restrictions remain
valid" (§78.1) and "validity obligations of other nested arenas remain satisfied" (§78.3) name no
checkable condition beyond `ArenaInv` and are not represented. -/
structure ResetPre (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Prop where
  /-- §78.1: the entry is live. -/
  live : s.Active E.internal
  /-- §78.1: `MetaRight`, exercisable `Modify` over the arena value (§36). -/
  metaRight : MetaRight s E
  /-- §78.2: no active authority derived from `internal` covers a leaf of the storage. -/
  noCover : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
    ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage
  /-- §78.3: no usable place depends on an anchor in the strict origin subtree of `internal`. -/
  noDeps : ResetNoDeps s E

/-- Decidability of `ResetPre` (§78). -/
instance (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : Decidable (ResetPre s E) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active E.internal ∧ MetaRight s E ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, E.internal ∈ s.ancs j → s.Active j →
      ∀ l ∈ s.afp j, l ∉ footprint s.P E.storage) ∧ ResetNoDeps s E)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d⟩⟩

/-- Kernel part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, Part XIV): the record of the `Modify`
derivation of `internal` over all the storage, already released; no leaf becomes `Init`. -/
def resetKEff (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ [⟨.modify, some E.internal, footprint s.P E.storage, .frame s.top, false⟩] }

/-- Metadata part of the effect of `reset` (§78 `ok` effect, §46): all leaves of the storage
become available; `issued` is cleared. -/
def resetMeta (s : S3) (E : ArenaEntry) : ArenaEntry :=
  { E with available := footprint s.P E.storage, issued := [] }

/-- Library state after an `ok` reset of entry `i` (§78). -/
def resetL (L : LState) (i : Nat) (E : ArenaEntry) : LState :=
  ⟨resetKEff L.kern E, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩

/-- The contract of `reset` on entry `i` (§78, §58): `ok` when the entry exists and the
preconditions hold, `reject` otherwise. -/
inductive ResetC (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetC i L .reject
  | reject {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ¬ ResetPre L.kern E → ResetC i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E → ResetPre L.kern E →
      ResetC i L (.ok (resetL L i E))

/-- `reset` as a derived operation (Part XIV, §78): `derive` of `internal` at `Modify` over the
footprint of the storage (O1), `release` of the derived authority (O3), then the explicit contract
check of §78.3; the metadata is updated on `ok`. -/
inductive ResetD (i : Nat) (L : LState) : Outcome3 LState → Prop where
  | noEntry : L.arenas[i]? = none → ResetD i L .reject
  | derive {E : ArenaEntry} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern .reject →
      ResetD i L .reject
  | release {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ .reject → ResetD i L .reject
  | contract {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ¬ ResetNoDeps L.kern E → ResetD i L .reject
  | ok {E : ArenaEntry} {s₁ s₂ : S3} : L.arenas[i]? = some E →
      DeriveStep E.internal (footprint L.kern.P E.storage) .modify L.kern (.ok s₁) →
      ReleaseStep L.kern.A.length s₁ (.ok s₂) → ResetNoDeps L.kern E →
      ResetD i L (.ok ⟨s₂, L.arenas.set i (resetMeta L.kern E)⟩)

import Ern.MemoryModel.Access.Basic

/-!
# Access kernel: operations O1–O16

The sixteen kernel operations of `specs/ERN_Memory_Model_Specification_v0.md` §60–§75. Each
operation has a precondition structure with one named field per clause item (or per condition of
an item), each field citing its clause; a `Decidable` instance; an effect function; and a step
relation over `Outcome3` (§58). Every operation except `alloc` is `Guarded` (`ok` or `reject`);
`alloc` may also `fail` (§58, §71). `KStep` is the union of their `ok` transitions.
-/

namespace Ern.MemoryModel.Access

/-- `mapI f i l` applies `f` to each element of `l` with its index counted from `i` (used by the
effects of §72 and §73). -/
def mapI {α β : Type} (f : Nat → α → β) : Nat → List α → List β
  | _, [] => []
  | i, a :: l => f i a :: mapI f (i + 1) l

/-! ## O1 `derive` (§60) -/

/-- Effect of `derive(source, region, mode)` (§60, `ok` effect): a new active authority of fresh
identity, origin `src`, mode `m`, footprint `region`, held by the current frame. -/
def deriveEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : S3 :=
  s.addAuth ⟨m, some src, region, .frame s.top, true⟩

/-- Preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
structure DerivePre (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) : Prop where
  /-- §60.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §60.1: `ExercisableAt(s, source, mode)`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src m
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` exist. -/
  leaves : ∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l
  /-- §60.2: the leaves of `region` belong to the footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src
  /-- §60.2: `mode` does not exceed the effective right of `source` on these leaves. -/
  modeOK : ∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m
  /-- §60.3: the addition preserves I1 (§50): an active authority outside the origin chain of the
  new one and sharing a leaf of `region` has own mode `Observe`, and so has the request. -/
  exclusive : ∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
    b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
    True
  /-- §60.4: the new holding frame is the live current frame. -/
  frameLive : s.top ∈ s.F

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `derive` (§60). -/
instance (s : S3) (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) :
    Decidable (DerivePre s src region m) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src m ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, l < s.P.length ∧ isLeaf s.P l) ∧ (∀ l ∈ region, l ∈ s.afp src) ∧
    (∀ l ∈ region, Allows (effective s src l) m) ∧
    (∀ b ∈ List.range s.A.length, OptP (s.A[b]?) (fun y => y.active = true →
      b ∉ src :: s.ancs src → (∃ l ∈ region, l ∈ y.footprint) → y.mode = .observe ∧ m = .observe)
      True) ∧
    s.top ∈ s.F)
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩,
     fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f, g⟩⟩

/-- `derive` as a relation (§60). -/
def DeriveStep (src : Nat) (region : List Nat) (m : Mode) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (DerivePre s src region m) (deriveEff s src region m)

/-! ## O2 `split` (§61) -/

/-- Effect of `split(source, regions)` (§61, `ok` effect): one active derived `Modify` authority
per region, held by the current frame. -/
def splitEff (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : S3 :=
  { s with A := s.A ++ rs.map fun r => ⟨.modify, some src, r, .frame s.top, true⟩ }

/-- Exclusive right already distributed by `src` on leaf `p` (§61.3): an active `Modify`
descendant of `src` covering `p`. -/
def DistribExcl (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Prop :=
  OptP (s.A[j]?) (fun y => y.active = true ∧ src ∈ s.ancs j ∧ p ∈ y.footprint ∧ y.mode = .modify)
    False

/-- Decidability of `DistribExcl` (§61.3). -/
instance (s : S3) (src j p : Nat) : Decidable (DistribExcl s src j p) := by
  unfold DistribExcl; infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `split` (§61). §61.4 is not a precondition (see the note of §61). -/
structure SplitPre (k : K) (s : S3) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) : Prop where
  /-- §61.1: `source` is active. -/
  active : s.Active src
  /-- §61.1: `source` is exercisable by the current frame in `Modify`. -/
  exercisable : s.ExercisableAt src .modify
  /-- §61.1: sufficient modification rights: effective `Modify` on every leaf of the regions. -/
  modifyOn : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify
  /-- §61.2: each region lies within the available footprint of `source`. -/
  within : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none
  /-- §61.3: regions are pairwise disjoint, structurally or by `K.DeclaredDisjoint`. -/
  disjoint : rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')
  /-- §61.3: no exclusive right already distributed is overlapped. -/
  notDistributed : ∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `split` (§61). -/
instance (k : K) [∀ r r', Decidable (k.DeclaredDisjoint r r')] (s : S3) (src : Nat)
    (rs : List (List Nat)) : Decidable (SplitPre k s src rs) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active src ∧ s.ExercisableAt src .modify ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, effective s src p = some .modify) ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, p ∈ s.afp src ∧ effective s src p ≠ none) ∧
    rs.Pairwise (fun r r' => (∀ l ∈ r, l ∉ r') ∨ k.DeclaredDisjoint r r') ∧
    (∀ r ∈ rs, ∀ p ∈ r, ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, ¬ DistribExcl s src j p))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e, f⟩⟩

/-- `split` as a relation (§61). -/
def SplitStep (k : K) (src : Nat) (rs : List (List Nat)) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (SplitPre k s src rs) (splitEff s src rs)

/-! ## O3 `release` (§62) -/

/-- Effect of `release(authority)` (§62, `ok` effect): the authority becomes inactive and leaves
the anchors of its holding place. -/
def releaseEff (s : S3) (a : Nat) : S3 := match s.A[a]? with
  | some x => { s with
      A := s.A.set a { x with active := false }
      D := fun q => if x.holder = .place q then (s.D q).filter (· != a) else s.D q }
  | none => s

/-- Right of the current frame on a holder (§62.2): the current frame itself, or a place on which
the current frame has exercisable `Modify`. -/
def HolderRight (s : S3) : Holder → Prop
  | .frame f => f = s.top
  | .place p => HasRight s .modify p

/-- Decidability of `HolderRight` (§62.2). -/
instance (s : S3) (h : Holder) : Decidable (HolderRight s h) := by
  cases h <;> unfold HolderRight <;> infer_instance

/-- Preconditions of `release` (§62). §62.5 is not represented. -/
structure ReleasePre (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Prop where
  /-- §62.1: the authority is active. -/
  active : s.Active a
  /-- §62.1: the authority is derived. -/
  derived : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False
  /-- §62.2: it is held by the current frame or by a place with exercisable `Modify`. -/
  holderRight : OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False
  /-- §62.3: no active descendant. -/
  noActiveDesc : ∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j
  /-- §62.3, §62.4: no usable place keeps `a` as anchor, except its holding place. -/
  anchors : ∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
    (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)

/-- Decidability of the preconditions of `release` (§62). -/
instance (s : S3) (a : Nat) : Decidable (ReleasePre s a) :=
  decidable_of_iff (s.Active a ∧ OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => y.origin ≠ none) False ∧
    OptP (s.A[a]?) (fun y => HolderRight s y.holder) False ∧
    (∀ j ∈ List.range s.A.length, a ∈ s.ancs j → ¬ s.Active j) ∧
    (∀ q ∈ List.range s.P.length, s.Usable q → a ∈ s.D q →
      (s.A[a]?).map (·.holder) = some (.place q)))
    ⟨fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩, fun ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩ => ⟨a, b, c, d, e⟩⟩

/-- `release` as a relation (§62). -/
def ReleaseStep (a : Nat) (s : S3) : Outcome3 S3 → Prop :=
  Guarded (ReleasePre s a) (releaseEff s a)
